Use-Cases & User Stories for U09_2, U09_19, U09_20, U09_26, U09_27

---

Use-Case 1: Simple System Navigation for Non-Computer Background Users

Actor: Non-Computer Background User
Main Flow: User accesses the system and navigates through it easily.
Alternative Flow: User requires assistance to navigate through the system.
Exception Flow: User encounters a system error while navigating.

---

Use-Case 2: Quick Consultation Request

Actor: Non-Computer Background User
Main Flow: User fills in a consultation request quickly.
Alternative Flow: User takes longer to fill in the consultation request.
Exception Flow: User encounters a system error while filling in the consultation request.

---

Use-Case 3: Installation Guide

Actor: Non-Computer Background User
Main Flow: User follows the installation guide to install the system.
Alternative Flow: User requires additional help to install the system.
Exception Flow: User encounters a system error while following the installation guide.

---

Use-Case 4: User Manual for End Users

Actor: Non-Computer Background User
Main Flow: User reads and understands the user manual.
Alternative Flow: User requires additional help to understand the user manual.
Exception Flow: User encounters a system error while reading the user manual.

---
